newsitem.title: USA: Printware in alliance with Autologic unit.
newsitem.headline: Printware in alliance with Autologic unit.

text.p: Printware Inc on Monday said it formed a strategic alliance with Xitron, a unit of Autologic Information International Inc.
Under the agreement, Printware will have exclusive rights to market the Harlequin ScripWorks Raster Image Processor (RIP) for Printware platesetters.
Raster image processors are key parts of computer-to-plate systems. They convert computer-based information into digital plates, which are used to produce printing plates.
"Broadening our product line will allow us to provide the right RIP for every customer," said Printware President Daniel Baker in a statement.
